newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras oil output up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras oil output up in 1996.

text.p: Brazilian oil output averaged 809,052 barrels per day (bpd) in 1996, up 13 percent from the average of 716,160 bpd produced in 1995, state energy company Petrobras said in a statement.

In December, average daily production was 888,501 barrels, around 46,000 barrels more than in the November average and very close to the record daily production of 900,000 barrels seen on November 12, it added.
The rise is due to the high operational efficiency of the Campos Basin which accounts for around 69 percent of total output and also to production and exploration in Rio Grande do Norte and Amazonia.
Natural gas production in 1996 was an average of 25.50 million cubic meters a day, a rise of 13.5 percent on the previous year.
Gas production in December was 26.90 million cubic meters a day, Petrobras said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
